relationships.stella-vermillion: Target of obsession; he wants to make her his doll by destroying everything she loves.
relationships.john-quedolan: Uses John as a puppet to murder and degrade his own comrades.
relationships.ascaride: The League sends Ascaride because he knows Or-Gaule's terror firsthand.
relationships.reisen-hiraga: One of Or-Gaule's 1762 remote puppets was Hiraga Reisen, destroyed by Stella in Japan.

periods.summary: In a hidden ruin in a Southeast Asian jungle, Or-Gaule replays footage of Stella destroying his Hiraga Reisen puppet and becomes fixated on possessing and corrupting her. He later appears in Quedolan's training facility, mocks the League's sanitized war system, and demonstrates overwhelming control through his Device Black Widow. Without moving, he manipulates Prince John into killing the Quedolan representatives and shattering his mind. He extends invisible threads across Quedolan, capturing soldiers, pregnant women, children, and others to create his Wonderland, setting the stage for the future Vermillion Battle.

key_events.summary: Chooses Stella as the object he wants to destroy and possess.
Manipulates John into slaughtering his own team.
His public movement triggers League emergency response.
